title: Universal Records warns against unauthorized use of Gehlee Dangca's content
summary: Universal Records Philippines on Friday has warned individuals and businesses against the unauthorized use of materials associated with singer Gehlee Dangca, saying it may pursue legal action against…

blocks.text: Universal Records Philippines on Friday has warned individuals and businesses against the unauthorized use of materials associated with singer Gehlee Dangca, saying it may pursue legal action against those who reproduce, distribute or commercially exploit her content without permission.
